seed: File > New opens the New window at Next defaults with no switch changed (the user's call on 2026-10-22: New makes an Image or a Video and nothing else). It holds the prompt bar, the two choices Image and Video, and the picked choice's sizes, and nothing about opening, capturing, UI design or Recent. Image is picked on arrival, so New Image straight away (one click) opens a 1440 by 1024 blank picture in a window of its own while the New window closes; Shift Command N then makes a new layer in it, Photoshop's key now that Command N is File > New. A second New window: Video picked by pointer renames the primary button New Video (the step finds the button by those words), HD 720p clicked by pointer, and New Video opens a 1280 by 720 video in its own window, the first picture's window still standing. The File menu is read at the end: New and New from Clipboard first, then Open and Open Recent, then the capture rows.

steps.note: The picture New Image made: 1440 by 1024, white, in a window of its own, with a second layer from Shift Command N. The New window is gone.
With Video picked and HD 720p clicked the primary button read New Video, and it opened a 1280 by 720 empty video in a window of its own while the New window closed.
